model_card.scope: tone classification with explicit 300 Hz boundary; not speech transcription
limitations: Small generated tasks and fixed splits do not establish natural-image perception, speech recognition, general instruction following or broad multimodal reasoning.
Greedy generation and intervention scores are measured separately; successful loading on generated input is not accuracy evidence.
The 300 Hz high/low boundary is a generated classification task; no speech transcription is established.
Amplitude/duration variants share a frequency family: 16/8/14 rows cover 8/4/7 train/validation/test frequencies.
The text_only_majority_accuracy field is a fixed-label baseline (always low = 8/14), not a measured text-only model. Blank audio makes this model answer high on all 14 rows (6/14 correct).
Shuffle accuracy 3/14 is scored against old answers; the paired raw-ID audit is 11/14 against the donor waveform truth, a different target rule.

training.loss_probe: same deterministic batch before and after training
training.timing_scope: optimizer loop including logging, periodic local checkpoints and CUDA synchronization; excludes probes, evaluation and final file write

data.split_policy: frequency family; amplitudes and durations remain together; high iff frequency >300 Hz

evaluation.scope: tone classification with explicit 300 Hz boundary; not speech transcription

paired_shuffle_audit.method: Recomputed from private report raw IDs before EOS against the replacement waveform donor answer; original reported shuffle accuracy retains the old target.

training_data.source: Generated sine tones grouped by frequency, labels high iff >300 Hz
training_data.modifications: Program-generated controlled records; family-level split before training.
